checks.evidence: Test 1 covers a portal page, an API endpoint and a static asset, but not back office pages or authenticated pages, so the range is only partly covered. Steps 1, 3 and 4 do verify the header on several response types.
Test 2 covers the 404 case, but no redirect response such as a redirect after sign-in is tested. The 404 half matches only partly.
Generated tests only check that max-age matches SDD §14 and never check a concrete value of at least 31536000.
Test 1 step 2 checks that includeSubDomains is present as specified in SDD §14, but it does not assert the directive explicitly and depends on the SDD content.
